# Matt Waldman's RSP Cast — 2024-01-29

**Raw transcript:** `raw/ingested/rsp-cast/2024-01-29-rsp-feel-it-or-fk-it-12924-an-rsp-cast-with-bob-harris-and-matt-waldman.md` (immutable — do not edit)

## Summary

*Feel It or F**k It* with co-host **Bob Harris** (not tracked; not [[Chris Harris]]). Three distinct segments.

**Conference Championship recap.** Detroit's NFC Championship loss to San
Francisco: Dan Campbell's aggressive fourth-down decisions defended as sound
process regardless of outcome, and Detroit framed as built for continued
success beyond 2023 (offensive line, [[Jared Goff]], [[David Montgomery]]/
[[Jahmyr Gibbs]], [[Amon-Ra St. Brown]], [[Sam LaPorta]]) even as the
Ben Johnson-to-Washington rumor firms up further. A new page,
[[Jameson Williams]], gets real but explicitly hedged optimism plus an
overdraft warning. San Francisco's win gets a [[Brock Purdy]] defense built
on supporting-cast strength ([[Christian McCaffrey]], [[Deebo Samuel]],
[[Brandon Aiyuk]], George Kittle) and a "subtle skills" framing. Baltimore's
AFC Championship loss to Kansas City gets extended [[Lamar Jackson]]
analysis — first year in Todd Monken's offense, a gutted receiver room
([[Rashad Bateman]], Odell Beckham Jr., Isaiah Likely/Mark Andrews, lost
J.K. Dobbins) — plus a specific 2024 redraft value call on Jackson relative
to two new pages, [[Patrick Mahomes]] and [[Jalen Hurts]] (whose own outlook
picks up a fresh variable: Philadelphia hiring Kellen Moore as OC). Kansas
City's win reinforces [[Travis Kelce]] (value pick, still functional),
[[Rashee Rice]] and [[Isiah Pacheco]], plus free-agency speculation naming
[[Mike Evans]] and [[Tee Higgins]] among Chiefs targets.

**Career-advice segment.** Extended advice for aspiring fantasy-content
creators (work-life balance, finding an original niche, "get reps"). Not
player- or team-relevant; not ingested as wiki content.

**Senior Bowl / Shrine Game scouting quick-hitters.** Real, if brief,
evaluative reads on eight 2024 draft prospects, all new pages:
[[Jabari Small]] and [[Blake Watson]] (RB, Shrine Game), [[Jonathan Brooks]]
(RB, Senior Bowl), [[Malik Washington]] and [[Xavier Legette]] (WR, Senior
Bowl), [[Spencer Rattler]] (QB, Senior Bowl), [[Malachi Corley]] (WR, Shrine
Game), and [[Javon Baker]] (WR, Senior Bowl). Existing page [[Ricky Pearsall]] gets a reinforcing update (Alec-Pierce-with-a-better-route-game
comp).

**Not given pages:** Odell Beckham Jr. and Isaiah Likely (dismissive
one-line mentions in the Baltimore receiver-room discussion, no standalone
evaluative take), Mark Andrews and J.K. Dobbins (injury-status mentions
only), Justice Hill and Gus Edwards (usage-complaint mention only, no
individual evaluation), Michael Pittman Jr. (named only as a free-agent
possibility, no evaluative content on his own play), Ladd McConkey
(dismissed in passing as "not actually underrated anymore," no positive or
negative evaluation given). Aaron Glenn and Mike
Macdonald mentioned only as defensive-coordinator head-coaching candidates —
out of scope. Chiefs defensive players (L'Jarius Sneed, Nick Bolton, Chris
Jones) mentioned only in an IDP-roster aside — out of scope for this wiki.
